reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a coherent regulatory and ethical framework for promotional integrity. The geo-state availability rules establish a foundational compliance layer that ensures offers are only rendered where legally permissible. The affiliate disclosure component enforces transparency requirements across all offer surfaces, aligning with FTC standards. The responsible play offer card introduces an ethical overlay that modifies standard ranking mechanisms to prioritize user welfare. These operators interact through a shared state space defined by regulatory compliance and user trust metrics. Failure modes include non-compliance with geo-rules leading to legal exposure, insufficient disclosure causing FTC violations, and improper ranking undermining trust. Dualities emerge between regulatory enforcement and ethical design, where each primitive serves both as a constraint and a mechanism for positive behavior shaping.
